cases.name: Eva Marie Clark
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a certified Esthetician and most recently worked as a quality control supervisor at VGT in Tulsa. Eva was a loving, devoted mother and her dedication and caring will always shine through her daughter's smile. Eva loved family, friends, art and music and was highly creative, witty, and loyal, all of which are evidenced in her daughter, Edie."

cases.name: Carla Kay Arrington
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a devoted Conoco Philips employee for over 40 years until her retirement in 2016. She had a passion for helping others and was always eager to share her love of baking to family and friends.  Carla would write handwritten cards for every occasion and sometimes “just because”. She cherished her friends and old coworkers and made it a point to stay connected over the years."
